name: CR-Int-15-partialfrac-3.b
questiontext:
By expressing the integrand as the sum of its partial fractions, find the following integral:
\[ \int {{CT:0}} d{{CT:1}}. \]

[[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]]
generalfeedback:
In order to calculate \[\int {{CT:0}} d{{CT:1}}\] we need to express \[{{CT:0}}\] as the sum of its partial fractions <hint>alg_partial_fractions</hint>.

\[\begin{array}{rcl}\displaystyle
 {{CT:0}} &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  {{CT:2}} \\
   &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  {{CT:3}}{{CT:4}} + {{CT:5}}{{CT:6}}
 \end{array}\]

By multiplying both sides by {{CT:7}} we get

\[\begin{array}{rcl}\displaystyle
 {{CT:8}} &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  {{CT:9}}+{{CT:5}} \\
   &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  {{CT:10}}
 \end{array}\]

Equating coefficients of {{CT:11}} we get a system of equations that can be solved to get \(A = {{CT:12}}\) and \(B = {{CT:12}}\).

So, \[{{CT:0}} = {{CT:13}}\]

Hence,

\[\begin{array}{rcl}\displaystyle
 \int {{CT:0}} d{{CT:1}} &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  \int {{CT:13}} d{{CT:1}} \\
   &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  {{CT:12}} \int {{CT:4}} d{{CT:1}} + {{CT:12}} \int {{CT:6}} d{{CT:1}} \\
   &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  {{CT:14}} + {{CT:15}} +c \\
   &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  {{CT:16}} +c
 \end{array}\]
